name: Borzavár (Hungary)
description: Divided per pall reversed into a dark brown upper part, a red hoist part and a green fly part, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Borzavár: a white and green shield with hills, a wavy stripe and a beech bough.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
